meta.about: Per-level story text: loading card, teaser, briefing plan (docs/unreal/maps/progression.md 7.2). text_<id>.json is the same object for the map levels and is merged over text.json by FMIText::Load.

plan: Three masters on this block: the avenue, the chop shop, the cage.
Every reel you grab brings more of them.
All three in hand, the IPX truck rolls from the lot.

loading.title: The Block
loading.line: Where it started. Three masters on one block.

block.teaser: Three back. The session sheet says nine. Six are still out, and the Vultures are running them to Canal Street.

location.tagline: Three more masters. One market. Tight corners.

mission.note: Take back three more masters and reach the IPX truck. About five minutes.

holdout.name: Hold Canal Street
holdout.note: Endless waves down Canal and out of every door. How long can you hold it?

mission: Take back three more master reels

intro.text: {name}, it's the Vault. Vultures moved three more masters to Canal — the tables, the market, the dub room. Bring them home.

introHoldout.text: {name}, it's the Vault. Vultures are coming out of every door on Canal. Hold the street.

reel.text: That's one. Canal heard it — more coming.
Two. They're pouring out of the back rooms.
All three. The IPX truck is idling at the east end of Canal. Cut through the arcade. Move.

done.text: Masters are in the vault. Canal's clean, {name}. They're taking what's left uptown.

plan: Three masters on Canal: a bootleg table out front, the market's cold room, the dub room off Mott.
Close quarters. They come out of doorways, not just the street ends.
The IPX truck waits at the east end of Canal.

loading.title: Canal Street
loading.line: They're cutting copies in the back rooms. Pull the masters out.

chinatown.teaser: Six home. The last three went uptown. Their buyer wants your album on the big screens over the square at midnight.

hints.reel4: Reel 4's on a table outside the market. South side of Canal.
hints.reel5: Back of the market. The cold room, by the west wall.
hints.reel6: The dub room's at the south end of Mott St. Its shutter's the only one up.
hints.extraction: The truck's at the east end of Canal. Cut through the arcade off the square.

location.tagline: Last three masters. Up top, then down.

mission.note: The last three masters, roof to street, then the IPX truck. About six minutes.

holdout.name: Hold the Square
holdout.note: Endless waves over the square. How long can you hold it?

mission: Take back the last three master reels

intro.text: {name}, it's the Vault. Last three masters are on these roofs and down in the square. Their buyer wants your album on the big screens at midnight. Not tonight.

introHoldout.text: {name}, it's the Vault. The square's full of Vultures. Hold it down as long as you can.

reel.text: One back. Every roof heard that. More coming.
Two. One left out there. They're throwing everything at you now.
That's all three. The IPX truck's rolling up on Forty-Sixth, east of the square. Move.

done.text: Every master's home. The city's yours, {name}.

plan: Three masters: the tank house up top, the gantry behind the big screen, the booth under the stand.
Work down the roofs. Stairs and the scaffold get you to the street.
When all three are in, the IPX truck comes for you on Forty-Sixth.

loading.title: Midtown
loading.line: Midnight over the square. Last three masters.

hints.reel7: The tanks are one roof down from the top. Steel stair on the east side of the high roof.
hints.reel8: The gantry's behind the big screen, on the low roof. Stairs at the south edge of the tank roof.
hints.reel9: The booth's under the stand, north end of the square. Scaffold off the gantry, or the service stair inside.
hints.extraction: The truck's on Forty-Sixth, east of the square. Down Broadway, past the bus.
